Total population.Summary: Population: Total population and distribution by age and sex estimated to be  consistent with the population by age and sex of the (a) 1959, 1970, 1979,  1989, 2001, 2011 censuses; (b) official estimates through 2017; (c)  adjusted to reflect de-facto population; and with estimates of the  subsequent trends in fertility, mortality and international migration.

Total fertility rate.Summary: Fertility: Total fertility rate and age pattern of fertility based on: (a) registered  births classified by age of mother and the underlying female population by  age through 2015; (b) birth-histories data from the 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015  DHS.

Life expectancy at birth.Summary: Overall Mortality: Life expectancy at birth and age pattern of mortality based on: (a)  official estimates through 2016; (b) adjusted for underregistration; (c)  adjusted for underreporting of infant and child deaths.

Infant/child mortality.Summary: Child Mortality: Under-five mortality based on: direct estimates from births and deaths  under-five calculated from full birth histories data from the 2000, 2005,  2010, 2015 DHS.  In addition, the official estimates of infant and child  mortality through 2017 have been considered.

International migration.Summary: Migration: International migration based on: estimates derived as the differences  between overall population growth and natural increase.
